As a junior, Reggi won the [[Dunlop Orange Bowl|Orange Bowl]] 16 and under in 1981.{{cite web |title=Raffaella Reggi |url=https://www.fitp.it/federazione/Storia/Campioni-e-record/raffaella-reggi |website=FITP}} She was a member of the Continental Players Cup Team in 1982. Reggi won the mixed doubles title at the [[US Open (tennis)|US Open]] in 1986, partnering [[Sergio Casal]].{{cite web |author1=Luca Alberto Montanari |title=Tennis, il ricordo di Raffaella Reggi a New York: «Annullai un match-point al primo turno e poi vinsi gli Us Open come Sara Errani» |url=https://www.settesere.it/it/notizie-romagna-tennis-il-ricordo-di-raffaella-reggi-a-new-york-annullai-un-match-point-al-primo-turno-e-poi-vinsi-gli-us-open-come-sara-errani-n46535.php |website=Setteserequi |language=Italian |date=15 September 2024}} She was a singles quarter-finalist at the [[French Open]] in 1987, and reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 13 in 1988. One of the highlights of her career was winning the [[Italian Open (tennis)|Italian Open]] in 1985, when she became the first Italian woman to win that tournament since Annelies Ullstein-Bossi claimed the title in 1950. Ullstein-Bossi, Reggi, the 2014 finalist [[Sara Errani]] and [[Jasmine Paolini]] in 2025 are the only Italian women to reach the singles final of Italy's top tennis tournament since [[World War II]]. Reggi finished her career with five singles titles and four doubles titles. She was a member of the [[Italy Fed Cup team|Italian Fed Cup]] team from 1982 through 1991 and the Italian Olympic Team in 1988 and 1992. She had career victories over [[Steffi Graf]], [[Chris Evert]], [[Evonne Goolagong]], [[Jana Novotná]], [[Hana Mandlíková]], [[Manuela Maleeva]], [[Nathalie Tauziat]], [[Helena Suková]], [[Claudia Kohde-Kilsch]], [[Zina Garrison]], and [[Jo Durie]]. ==Grand Slam finals== ===Mixed Doubles: 1 (1 title)=== {| class="sortable wikitable" !Result !Year !style="width:130px"|Championship !style="width:50px"|Surface !style="width:145px"|Partner !style="width:145px"|Opponents !style="width:75px" class="unsortable"|Score |- | style="background:#98fb98;"|Win || [[1986 US Open (tennis)|1986]] || style="background:#ccccff;"|[[US Open (tennis)|US Open]] || Hard || {{flagicon|ESP}} [[Sergio Casal]] || {{flagicon|USA}} [[Martina Navratilova]]
